data.name: Equine Therapy
data.headline: All ages • Up to 2 people • 45 minutes • Enjoy the desert while experiencing the magic of the horses
data.description:
#Come experience the magic of the herd!					

##Duration

45 minutes 
				
##About					

Cascade Trails Mustang Sanctuary has a huge heart for animals and wanted to create a safe environment for those in need. Wild mustangs were welcomed immediately, and the herd continues to grow. We invite guests to come interactively experience the herd through equine therapy. Cascade Trails is a unique experience created by impassioned owners who are personally committed to saving the wild mustangs. We are dedicated to authenticity and gracious, personalized service. Our sanctuary is a perfect blend of the desert enchantment and the magic of the herd.
data.cancellation_notes: Cancellations made at least 7 days prior to the session will receive a full refund. Please call to reschedule or receive a gift card. 100% will be charged for last minute cancellations. Chronic reschedules will get charged $15 per rescheduled session.
